overview_description.description:
Edyst is an early stage online learning & employability startup for aspiring software developers. Their solutions aim to make students learn the most in-demand technical skills needed by the industry, keep them immersed and addicted to the learning process and connect them to prospective employers.

Edyst was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

product.name: Data Science Internships
product.description: Short-term internships teaching data science concepts and practical skills using Python and tools like numpy, pandas, and scikit-learn.

product.name: Online Coding Bootcamps
product.description: Structured online courses covering programming languages, data structures, algorithms, and software development skills.

product.name: Placement Preparation and Interview Training
product.description: Training and resources to prepare students for technical interviews and job placements in IT companies.

product.name: Company-Specific Preparation Packs
product.description: Curated question sets and mock tests tailored to the hiring processes of specific IT companies.

product.name: Real-Time Projects and Mini-Projects
product.description: Hands-on projects using programming languages and APIs to build practical applications.
